headline_seed: Houthis claim attacks on Saudi Arabian oil facility and Yemeni port, and other Mideast news - AP News
draft_text:
Yemen's Houthis claimed a drone strike on a Saudi Aramco refinery in Jizan. AP and NPR report the fire was extinguished — no injuries. Saudi Arabia did not confirm the cause.

At least 30 troops killed in separate Houthi attacks Thursday.

And that's the mews.
